ops.body: Root scope decision: defer optional daemonkit task3419f1a. Do not run or land the classifier-rejected test/change, and do not work around that denial via another tool. Preserve its isolated patch/reproducer unpushed and unverified. The existing GoAway teardown delay (observed ~1.2s, bounded up to10s after peer rejection) is a known limitation, not a reason to block the four-repo implementation. Document that residual latency precisely; do not claim strict caller-deadline adherence on that error path. Continue the whole approved cc-sync/synckit/reposync/Orca objective, final verification/QA/PRs. No fifth-repo expansion is needed in this turn.
